summary: Inventiva S.A. filed a Form 6-K on May 22, 2026, publishing a notice of its Ordinary and Extraordinary General Meeting scheduled for June 30, 2026. The agenda includes routine items such as approval of financial statements, appropriation of profit/loss, ratification of a prior subscription agreement with Samsara BioCapital, approval of executive compensation policies, and director nominations/renewals. No special-situation event—such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private, or restructuring—is disclosed. The filing is a standard routine meeting notice. Therefore, no special-situations category applies.
